source.title: A survey on the theory of orthogonal systems and some open problems

trace.notes: Input URL was normalized as a zbMATH resolver record with document ID 4142743. Direct shell access to https://zbmath.org/4142743 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403, so the zbMATH API was used only for identity metadata.

zbMATH API metadata identified the work as M. M. Djrbashian, "A survey on the theory of orthogonal systems and some open problems", Zbl 0697.42016, in Orthogonal polynomials: theory and practice, NATO ASI Series C 294, pages 135-146, 1990. The API exposed no full-text links.

Exact-work recovery found the matching Springer chapter DOI 10.1007/978-94-009-0501-6_6, but the Springer page is a subscription preview containing only abstract, references, and citation metadata. The direct chapter PDF endpoint redirected to authentication/HTML rather than a readable PDF.

Bounded exact-title searches for the title plus PDF, DOI, author, and book title returned only the Springer preview and secondary works citing the chapter. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered.

Source adequacy gate failed. No questions were extracted because available materials were resolver metadata, abstract/preview text, citation records, search snippets, or secondary references rather than the chapter's full problem statements.
Saved JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-4142743.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
